notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE - non VR and gamepad support
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Adventurers,[/h1]

Over the past 8 months since the last update, I have been reworking the game architecture to better support VR and to add a non-VR play mode with full gamepad support.

[b]WHAT IS NEW:[/b]
[list]
[*] non-VR mode with dedicated menus
[*] main VR mode works best when using OpenXR / SteamVR
[*] complete overhaul of the game logic to support both VR and non VR
[*] menu option for V-sync, which is ON by default
[*] new store page assets
[*] new playable character model
[*] basic save mode
[/list]

[b]WHAT WILL BE ADDED:[/b]
[list]
[*] more levels
[*] pickable for dragons
[*] traps, puzzle logic
[*] more biomes
[*] more languages
[*] more sounds, animation
[/list]

[b]WHAT WILL BE FIXED:[/b]
[list]
[*] VR icons are currently not correctly displaying inputs
[*] game over logic
[*] game score logic on level end
[*] minor position issues, when moving your characters
[/list]

It would be very welcome, if at this stage you can inform me of any VR issues or general technical bugs. Thank you for your support!

[b]GENERAL UPDATE FROM THE DEVELOPER[/b]

It took a long time, but from here on, the game will be updated more frequently with new levels, more tutorials, and other interactions!

The newest game build is currently very small and more open to feedback for those of you who are still interested in checking it out and providing your thoughts.

Stay tuned for more updates, and stay safe and healthy!


Cheers & thank you! Happy gaming!
Simon, Dragon Snack Developer

notes.content:

This release has some basic levels, with core mechanics that will be mixed in future updates to create some interesting puzzle variations!

All four dragons are playable:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25115982/b6a39da009573ea6cc6811200ba5449bc9c23201.png[/img]
Draco - controls like a standard third person character

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25115982/dd243713c8b55c6f163929e9758f608f05ddfded.png[/img]
Dralth - point & click dragon wand controls, 2 abilities - JUMP & DASH

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25115982/09c19f55883a950aac0489bf42ee57c75be2c7ed.png[/img]
Hiradolth - point & click dragon wand controls, 2 abilities - SHIELD & SLOW FALL

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25115982/a0075cdad8756da5d11c29398e807bff50be3166.png[/img]
Tamolth -  point & click dragon wand controls, 2 abilities - BITE & FIREBALL

Visit Discord forum here:

https://discord.gg/fAjVRw3

You can share your feedback on bugs / other issues and help in further development ! 

YOUR FEEDBACK IS KEY and will definitely make the game better, nearing its final release. I'll make sure to read every comment and also post updates on further development here and on Discord.


If you want to know more about the game, please check my YT channel for video updates:
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCucLRnBhW5lGXkN9GFjiPFA

You can also visit the games website:
https://dragonsnackproductions.com/

Take care and see you in VR space! []-)

notes.title: Draco DUX
notes.content:
Hello there Dragon leaders!

DracoDUX  is an action adventure VR game with two view perspectives. Explore each level and  help your dragons return to their homeland!

Each dragon has unique abilities, which you have to utilize to complete a level. Every level is aimed to be something new to complete and challenging for the Dragons and the Player.

GAME KEY FEATURES :

- explore various levels navigating Dragons with point & click / thumbstick movement
- 2 perspectives 20:1 playground view and normal scale point of view
- solve puzzle elements with your dragons, each with their own abilities
- use explosives to defeat your enemies
- turn your room into a virtual playbox adventure

Take your time to explore each level and turn your room into a VR adventure!

notes.title: DracoDux Valve Index new Demo is out!
notes.content:
2019/06/28 DEMO UPDATE & Index Support

Hello everyone!

I am happy to annouce, that now Draco Dux supports Valve Index controllers. The demo version from 2016 has also been updated. New graphics and gameplay mechanics have been added, as well as a set of tutorial levels.

The game will be developed into a full product very soon, so stay tuned for news and updates.

Leave your feedback and have fun playing Draco Dux Demo!

notes.title: DracoDux DEMO -> ONLINE!
notes.content:
Hello !

you can now try my EARLY DEMO of DracoDux.

This is a small taste of what the full game will feature. Every demo level is basic and will be improved in many various ways and iterations.

Full game will feature additional controllable characters with unique abilities and a main hero of the story - DRAX!

I love video games, and decided to make a game I always wanted to play and get immersed with the help of VR!

I hope you'll like my different approach in DRAGON LEADER = DRACO DUX!

Have fun playing!

--------------------------------
PLEASE NOTE:

I wasn't able to make a STEAM EARLY access, but instead wanted to share a playable game build with you as soon as I could. That is the reason why this DEMO is called an EARLY DEMO.
Thus said it may contain some bugs, therefore any feedback on the game left in a separate post, will be very helpfull for me to adress all the issues in the full game.

Thank you!
--------------------------------
